wrapper_delta.scope: test-only local wrapper, CPU port exposure only; same production WT/controller/DMA/IOMMU RTL and memory delay
wrapper_delta.tag_semantics: Read IDLE request carries index; following READ cycle carries accepted previous tag. On hit response and next grant same cycle, old tag/new index are independently driven; miss/replay pending tag remains stable.

cpu_copy_feasibility.source: full original A region0..8191 remains owned during copy, allowing aligned8B closure loads; original payload and guards unchanged
cpu_copy_feasibility.algorithm: per-span sequential aligned64bit real source loads; each actual returned byte stream packed into aligned destination64bit values with exact BE. Retain one partial destination word; enqueue complete words. Independent read and store pumps: permit next read grant on hit response cycle and issue all available store2 words concurrently, subject only to real port grants/writebuffer and read-controller/MSHR restrictions. No software one-global-pending cap. Store queue contains only actual returned source-derived words. Source descriptor vector and pending read storage, partial word and actual peak store queue occupancy are separately reported; allocation/instruction time unknown null.
cpu_copy_feasibility.new_validation: one bounded interface microcase for independent port/read-nexttag/unaligned stitching, optional required before root finalgate, not old accepted microtests

scheduler.callback: poll all active engine0 then1 at completed legal CPU operation boundary, supply ready successor NEXT and prepare next before prefix service; callback never during fence/halt or nested prefix service
scheduler.eager: snapshot and claim all currently complete contiguous packets, one DMA controller/cache fence per claimed prefix; then used publish and true ordered consumers. Later completions discovered during consumer legal boundaries queued for next outer prefix service. CPU uses WT drains without DMA fence.
scheduler.batch: continuous public polling/refill until all copy packet completions; no early B consumer; DMA one fresh fence covers all3 then used metadata publication prefix then original ordered consumers. CPU one ordinary WT drain before batchpublication; source logical return immediately at safe read boundary and physical field6 store may be deferred but individually traced.

metadata.source_return: logical A_returned event separate from actual source_return metadata store/drain retirement; no source overwrite or reuse
metadata.publication: all claimed prefix metadata stores then one ordinary WT drain, common group release event and used_publish perpacket; source marker retirement tracked only for snapshotted actual field6 stores
